Be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance (U.S. citizenship is a pre-requisite) as well as Program Special access within a reasonable period of time, as determined by the company to meet its business needs (U.S. citizenship is a pre-requisite)

fresh_leads.title: Materials & Process Engineering Intern, Summer 2027
fresh_leads.qualification_text: We are looking for a Materials & Process Engineering Intern to support impactful projects within BAE Systems' Materials & Process Engineering department. Contribute to materials and process development, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and apply analytical skills. Ideal for students in their sophomore or junior year with a relevant engineering degree. Full-Time Engineering & Technology
